run_f_gold_left_rotate: run f_gold to left-rotate an array k times by moving the first element to the end
test_f_gold_rotation: test f_gold against f_filled using hardcoded parameter sets to verify array left rotation correctness
refactor_f_gold_efficiency: refactor f_gold to use slicing instead of nested loops for O(n) array left rotation
review_f_gold_inplace: review f_gold which modifies the input array in-place during each left rotation step
summarize_f_gold_algorithm: summarize f_gold algorithm that performs k successive left rotations on an array of size n
